summary: LIPTA AS (org. no. 987 352 744) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-10-25. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 11.7 m. Board chair: Anders Eivind Eide; auditor: REVISJONSFIRMAET FLATTUM & CO AS. Also: LEI 254900ZQXP2Z1T2MDK77.
